name: Readwise
description: Send a note to Readwise Reader, and get your highlights back on the note they came from.

board.description: The outline other highlights land in (default readwise)

page.description: The page in the board outline they land under (default readwise)

publish.description: Sending publishes the note, unlisted (default true; false sends without publishing)

link.description: The URL a sent note gets in Reader (default its public permalink)

machine.description: This machine's name in ep0ch:// links

tags.description: Tags a sent document gets in Reader (default ["ep0ch"])

locations.description: Which Reader locations the library mirrors (add "feed" for RSS)

readerPage.description: The page in the board outline the Reader library lands under (default reader)

api.description: Readwise's address (default https://readwise.io); a test points it at a fake

actions.label: Send to Reader
actions.description: Saves the note and its children to Reader

actions.label: Pull Readwise highlights
actions.description: Brings in highlights changed since the last pull

actions.label: Pull the Reader library
actions.description: Mirrors your Reader documents, a block each
